description: Read one Wisty UI item to choose and compose it: its install command, examples by name, When to use, When not to use, Usage, Rules, API reference.

sections.description: Only these parts, under the title and install command. Without it, the parts above; the rest, on how the item already behaves, come only when named here.

source.description: Add the installable files, for reading or copying by hand. Rarely needed: install with the shadcn command.

style.description: The "style" in the project's components.json, like "radix-nova" or "base-nova": it picks the Radix or Base UI version. Leave it out for the Radix version.

name: get_component
title: Read a Wisty UI item

description: Get one example's code for a Wisty UI item, for the project's base: a complete, working use to adapt.

example.description: The example's name, like "default", as get_component lists them. Leave it out for the first, which shows the job the item is for.

style.description: The "style" in the project's components.json, like "radix-nova" or "base-nova": it picks the Radix or Base UI version. Leave it out for the Radix version.

name: get_example
title: Read a Wisty UI example

description: Get the steps to install one Wisty UI item: the shadcn command, and the theme and icon steps it needs. First read style and tailwind.css from the project's components.json, and whether it has a src/ folder; a project without components.json runs npx shadcn@latest init first.

srcDir.description: Whether the project has a src/ folder. Left out, a tailwindCss under src/ means yes.

style.description: The "style" in the project's components.json, like "radix-nova" or "base-nova": it picks the Radix or Base UI version.

tailwindCss.description: The "tailwind.css" path as components.json gives it, like "src/index.css", for the exact theme import lines.

themed.description: True when the stylesheet already has Wisty UI's theme (--color-page in its @theme inline, or a tokens.css import), to leave the theme step out.

name: get_install_command
title: Install a Wisty UI item

description: List every Wisty UI item by kind, with its first sentence. Primitives are shadcn's own components with the Salesforce look; components are what shadcn lacks, like lookup; blocks are finished Salesforce sections over sample data; helpers turn records into a block's props. Prefer search_components when you know the job.
name: list_components
title: List Wisty UI

description: Find Wisty UI items by the job they do, best first. Each match gives its name, kind (primitive, component, block, helper) and description. A block is a finished section built from components and primitives over sample data, to install and edit: when the job is a whole section, start from its block, not its parts. Read a match with get_component.

query.description: One to three keywords for the job, like "record picker", "picklist" or "confirm delete", not a sentence.

name: search_components
title: Search Wisty UI
